# Concept

* [AdamW and Muon optimization](adamw-and-muon-optimization.md) - Nanochat's parameter-aware combination of adaptive AdamW updates and orthogonalized Muon matrix updates.
* [Bits per byte](bits-per-byte.md) - A tokenizer-aware language-model compression metric normalized by underlying UTF-8 bytes.
* [Byte-pair encoding](byte-pair-encoding.md) - A subword vocabulary learned by repeatedly merging frequent adjacent symbols.
* [Chat formatting](chat-formatting.md) - The deterministic mapping between structured conversation messages and model tokens.
* [Compute-optimal training](compute-optimal-training.md) - Choosing model size and token budget to use a fixed training-compute envelope effectively.
* [Decoder-only transformers](decoder-only-transformers.md) - Causal transformer stacks that learn next-token distributions and generate autoregressively.
* [FlashAttention](flash-attention.md) - Exact attention kernels organized to reduce expensive memory traffic.
* [Gradient accumulation and distributed training](gradient-accumulation-and-distributed-training.md) - Building a large token batch from microbatches spread across devices and optimizer steps.
* [Grouped-query attention](grouped-query-attention.md) - Attention with many query heads sharing a smaller set of key/value heads.
* [Inference and sampling](inference-and-sampling.md) - Turning a checkpoint and prompt into tokens through prefill, cached decoding, and a sampling policy.
* [KV caching](kv-caching.md) - Reuse of attention keys and values from earlier tokens during autoregressive decoding.
* [Language-model evaluation](language-model-evaluation.md) - Separating predictive compression, benchmark capability, chat behavior, and generation inspection.
* [Low-precision training](low-precision-training.md) - Using compact numerical formats for selected training operations while preserving stable state where needed.
* [Preference and policy optimization](preference-and-policy-optimization.md) - Post-training objectives that alter a model using preference pairs or rewards from sampled behavior.
* [Pretraining data curation](pretraining-data-curation.md) - Selecting, cleaning, deduplicating, mixing, and validating documents before language-model training.
* [RMS normalization](rms-normalization.md) - Activation normalization by root mean square without subtracting the mean.
* [Rotary position embeddings](rotary-position-embeddings.md) - Position-dependent rotations applied to attention queries and keys.
* [Supervised fine-tuning](supervised-fine-tuning.md) - Updating a pretrained model on examples of desired prompts, conversations, and responses.
